title: 第32章 食堂出公差，掐大米
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “连长好！”突然，老兵们神色一变。赶紧把烟头丢地上，冲门口来人敬礼。周凯东一个激灵，连忙转过头去。果不其然高峰正皮笑肉不笑的，像个鬼一样站在身后。他奶奶的，连长平时压根不来这儿上厕所的，怎么忽然改口味了？周凯东心虚的敬礼：“连长好...”高峰摆摆手：“其他人出去，一排长留下。”其余人立马鱼贯而出，临走前给他一个“你倒大霉了，自求多福”的表情。周凯东也是满脸尴尬，赶紧解释：“连长，我不是那意思，我的意思是......”高峰抬手打断：“纠正你一个错误，新兵连不是我家开的，下连分配不是我一个人说了算。”“我这个新兵连连长只是负责拟订人员名单，具体情况还得由团长签字同意，不是说来个人想挑哪个就挑哪个。”“我要真那么牛逼，就不是来这当你们连长，而是当你们副营长了。”“是是是！”周凯东连连点头，但却在心里却低估起来。谁不知道，新兵连长都是近水楼台先得月。优先会把好苗子全都拦到自已老部队，最好的那一茬先挑完了，才轮到其他人。每年团里搞新训，都有不少连长争着抢着想要来担任新兵连长，为的就是给自已多划拉一些好兵。毕竟，下连后分配的新兵质量，决定了这支部队的未来实力强弱，所以人人都想要最好的苗子。“我来的时候，瞧见你们班的兵，没人看着还能自觉训练。”“丁腾飞那个兵，好像也慢慢开始融入集体，被大家接纳了。”“蛮好的，就得往这个方向保持，你出去吧。”“是。”周凯东刚转身，就又被连长叫住。“带烟了吗？”“带了。”“小苏？不是有更好的吗？”周凯东眼皮直跳，看来连长早就来了，一直在外头趴墙根偷听呢！他赶紧将剩下的华子掏出来，高峰拿过后点了一根，剩下的全部揣进兜里。“以后不许随便打赌，烟也不行，下不为例。”周凯东也是人麻了，合着啥好处也没捞着，说没收就给没收了。连长也太腹黑了点儿，得亏自已不是他们单位的兵，要不然一天天有够受的。从厕所出来，远远的就瞧见器械训练场上，正在自主训练的三班新兵，这让周凯东很是欣慰。能够从一个个抗拒训练，变着法儿的偷懒，到能够在没人看着的情况下主动去训练。这又何尝不是一种进步？这帮小子，正在一点点的被部队潜移默化的改变。从一名社会青年，慢慢变得像一名军人，最后成为一名真正的军人。......“一排长，轮到你们班出公差了，要两个去食堂帮忙。”训练途中，值班员跑过来通知一声，周凯东随即点了两个。“陆阳，丁腾飞，出列。”“你们俩，去出个公差。”“是。”陆阳脱离队伍，和丁腾飞一起朝着食堂那边过去。眼前系统光幕弹出，简单做了个知识补充。【检测到新知识点：出公差！】【知识点分析：部队里出公差并非外出，而是指被干部抽调出来为集体干活。内容多为打扫卫生、采购、跑腿、拔草等。】虽说并没有什么双倍经验加持，但能够接触到新鲜事物的陆阳依旧很高兴。起初，丁腾飞以为出公差就是外出，激动了好一会。可听完陆阳的解释，立马就变得提不起兴趣。他最烦干活，班上的活儿都不想干，更别说是给集体干活了。进了食堂，陆阳二人四下瞅了瞅，并没有老兵来安排他们具体任务。“嘿，你俩，傻站着干嘛呢？”“跟我过来！”二人赶紧跟他来到食堂后头的巷子。边上停靠一辆食堂采购用依维柯，车上起码有四五十包大米。领他们来的炊事兵叫刘诚，是个二拐的上等兵，说话时一副趾高气昂的样子。“你们的活儿，就是把车上的米面油和瓜果蔬菜，统统卸下到仓库里码放整齐。”“就我俩？”丁腾飞一听这么多活儿，当即就不爽了。这么些搬完得到什么时候，还不得累死？就这还不如回操场上训练呢，起码中途还能休息。“这么多东西，得搬到什么时？”“搬到什么时候是你们的事，结束了把再把米给掐了。”“等会儿，把米给掐了，米怎么掐？”“呵呵，被子怎么叠，米就怎么掐，要四四方方规规整整，像砖头一样顺墙边码放，抓紧时间！”说罢，这个刘诚便装模作样的捋起袖子，看看手腕上并不存在的手表，这才背着手离开了。部队里，不光被子四四方方，大米和抹布都得是正方形的。甚至于，就连下雪堆得雪人，也都是方的。但这就给陆阳等人增加了非常大的工作量，毕竟这里好几十包大米呢。见那人走开，丁腾飞直接啐了一口：“真特么傻叉，不过比咱多当了一年兵而已，指指点点装的跟干部似的，我真想给他俩耳刮子！”陆阳很少和丁腾飞站同一边，因为他也有同感。先前那个炊事兵说话语气实在让人讨厌，始终一副高高在上的姿态。部队里，总有些家伙仗着多当了两年兵，想要拿捏新兵找存在感。这家伙明显是在厨房里被使唤惯了，碰上新兵立马觉得自已支棱起来，拿他们当软柿子。好在系统提示搬运过程中，可以强化臂力，腰力，陆阳这才心里平衡一些。但却没想到干活儿的过程中，这家伙又特么出现了。拿着个保温杯站在边上当起监工，还不停的指手画脚。明明两个人忙的转起来了，一刻没停，却还是被刁难说偷懒，码放的不够整齐，水果蔬菜没有轻拿轻放。甚至还说，回头要是瓜果蔬菜出现磕碰损失，要找他们算账之类的话。这下子，就连一向好脾气的陆阳都忍不了了，气的直接把大米往他脚边一摔。“你来干！？”
content_en: "Hello, company commander!" Suddenly, the expressions of the veterans changed.He quickly threw the cigarette butt on the ground and saluted the person coming to the door.Zhou Kaidong was startled and quickly turned his head.Sure enough, Gao Feng was smiling and standing behind him like a ghost.His grandma's, the company commander usually doesn't come here to use the toilet at all, why did he suddenly change his taste?Zhou Kaidong saluted guiltily: "Hello, company commander..." Gao Feng waved his hand: "Others go out, and the platoon leader stays." The rest of the people filed out immediately, and before leaving, they gave him an expression of "You are in bad luck, you are asking for more blessings."Zhou Kaidong also looked embarrassed and quickly explained: "Company commander, I didn't mean that, I meant..." Gao Feng raised his hand and interrupted: "I'm going to correct you. The recruit company is not run by my family, and I don't have the final say in the allocation of the next company." "I, the recruit company commander, am just responsible.The specific details of the drafting of the personnel list must be signed by the regimental commander.It does not mean that anyone can pick whoever they want.""If I were really that good, I wouldn't be here to be your company commander, but to be your deputy battalion commander." "Yes, yes!" Zhou Kaidong nodded repeatedly, but he underestimated it in his heart.Who doesn't know that new company commanders are the first to get the upper hand?Priority will be given to blocking all the good seedlings to his old team. The best ones will be selected first, and then it will be the turn of others.Every year when the regiment holds new training, there are many company commanders vying to serve as company commanders of new recruits, in order to attract more good soldiers to themselves.After all, the quality of the recruits assigned after the next company determines the future strength of this unit, so everyone wants the best seedlings."When I came here, I saw that the soldiers in your class were still training consciously when no one was watching." "That soldier Ding Tengfei seemed to be slowly starting to integrate into the group and was accepted by everyone." "It's good. You have to keep in this direction. You can go out." "Yes." As soon as Zhou Kaidong turned around, he was stopped by the company commander again."Did you bring cigarettes?" "Yes." "Xiao Su? Isn't there something better?" Zhou Kaidong's eyelids jumped. It seemed that the company commander had been here a long time ago and had been leaning against the wall outside to eavesdrop!He quickly took out the remaining Huazi. Gao Feng took it and lit one, then put the rest in his pocket."In the future, you are not allowed to bet casually, and you are not allowed to smoke either. This will not happen next time." Zhou Kaidong was also confused. He didn't get any benefits from the cooperation, and it was confiscated when he was told.The company commander was also a bit shady. It was a good thing that he was not a soldier of their unit, otherwise he would have suffered enough every day.After coming out of the toilet, he saw the third class of recruits training independently on the equipment training ground from a distance, which made Zhou Kaidong very happy.From being able to resist training one by one and being lazy in various ways, to being able to take the initiative to train without anyone watching.Isn't this a kind of progress?These boys are being subtly changed by the army little by little.From a social youth, he gradually became like a soldier, and finally became a real soldier...."Platoon leader, it's your class's turn to go on a business trip, and we need two to go to the canteen to help." During the training, the attendant ran over to inform, and Zhou Kaidong immediately ordered two."Lu Yang, Ding Tengfei, come out." "You two, go on an errand." "Yes." Lu Yang left the team and headed towards the canteen with Ding Tengfei.The system light curtain pops up in front of me, and I simply add some knowledge.[New knowledge point detected: business trip!】【Knowledge point analysis: A business trip in the army does not mean going out, but refers to being drawn out by cadres to work for the collective.The content is mostly about cleaning, purchasing, running errands, pulling weeds, etc.】Although there is no double experience blessing, Lu Yang is still very happy to be exposed to new things.At first, Ding Tengfei thought that going on a business trip meant going out, and he was excited for a while.But after listening to Lu Yang's explanation, he immediately became uninterested.He hated working the most and didn't want to do any work in the class, let alone work for the collective.After entering the cafeteria, Lu Yang and the two looked around, but there were no veterans to arrange their specific tasks."Hey, you two, what are you doing standing around?" "Come with me!" The two of them quickly followed him to the alley behind the canteen.There was a car parked nearby to buy Iveco for the canteen. There were at least forty or fifty bags of rice on the car.The cook who led them here was called Liu Cheng. He was a second-class soldier who spoke with an air of arrogance."Your job is to unload all the rice, flour, oil, fruits and vegetables from the car into the warehouse and stack them neatly." "Just the two of us?" Ding Tengfei immediately felt unhappy when he heard that there was so much work.How long will it take to finish moving all this before we die from exhaustion?It's better to go back to the playground to train. At least you can rest in the middle."When do you have to move so many things?" "It's your business when to move it. I'll pinch the rice when it's over." "Wait a minute, pinch the rice. How do you pinch the rice?" "Haha, the rice should be pinched how you fold the quilt. It should be square and neat, stacked along the wall like bricks, hurry up!" After that, Liu Cheng pretended to roll up his sleeves, looked at the non-existent watch on his wrist, and left with his hands behind his back.In the army, not only were the quilts square, but the rice and rags had to be square.In fact, even the snowman made of snow is square.But this added a lot of workload to Lu Yang and others. After all, there were dozens of bags of rice here.Seeing the man walking away, Ding Tengfei spat directly: "What a fool. He only served as a soldier for one year longer than us. He points and pretends to be a cadre. I really want to give him a slap in the face!" Lu Yang rarely stands on the same side as Ding Tengfei because he feels the same way.The cook's tone before was really annoying, and he always had a condescending attitude.In the army, there are always some guys who want to take advantage of the fact that they have been in the army for two more years and want to make a difference with the new recruits.This guy was obviously used to being bossed around in the kitchen. When he met the new recruits, he immediately felt self-conscious and used them as a soft persimmon.Fortunately, the system reminded him to strengthen his arm and waist strength during the transportation process, so Lu Yang felt more balanced.But I didn't expect that this guy would show up again during the work.He stood on the side with a thermos cup and acted as a supervisor, and he kept pointing fingers.It was clear that the two of them were busy working without stopping for a moment, but they were still being teased for being lazy, not stacking the fruits and vegetables neatly enough, and not handling the fruits and vegetables with care.He even said that if there was any damage to fruits and vegetables later, he would have to settle the accounts with them.At this moment, even Lu Yang, who had always been good-tempered, couldn't bear it anymore and threw the rice at his feet in anger."You do it!?"
